1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 c6 5.Nf3.strategy: Develops the knight and guards d4 and e5 while the bishop keeps the f6 knight pinned to the queen, since Black has not played ...Be7. White builds a space advantage on a solid structure, while Black's ...c6 holds d5 and keeps the option of taking on c4, which makes for a slow game.
